bio: Enjoy a luxurious afternoon tea for two at the Wivenhoe House Hotel in Colchester. Enjoy an opulent afternoon tea experience for two at Colchester's Grade II listed Wivenhoe House Hotel.  You and your companion will get to recline in the elegant brasserie and marvel at the tiers of delicious treats served to you by the attentive staff. Finger sandwiches will provide dainty savoury treats with classic fillings while the scones are freshly home-baked and accompanied by clotted cream and Tiptree jam. You'll also enjoy fine pastries and cakes impossible to resist! You'll get to choose from a wide range of exotic Drury teas and coffees for the perfect accompaniment to a memorable culinary treat.
